school.name: Hostos-Lincoln Academy of Science
school.overview: Our school is a collaboration between the Department of Education and the City University of New York. In four years, our students are expected to graduate with a Regents diploma granted by the Department of Education and an Associate Degree from Hostos Community College. Students take high school classes at our St. Ann's site and college classes at the college.
